GOOD TO KNOW

Questions,
answered.

Sample content below can be replaced with your own policies, preparation notes, and service FAQs in WordPress.

How do I request an appointment?+

This is a demonstration website. No bookings are being accepted. In a finished WordPress site, this section can link to a configured appointment plugin or inquiry form.

Can I customize the services shown here?+

Yes. Services and business details can be adapted for salons, spas, estheticians, wellness studios, and related beauty businesses.

Does this theme include a booking plugin?+

No booking plugin is bundled or activated. A live appointment workflow requires a separately installed, configured, and tested plugin.
